title: Ruby Language Basics
intro: Ruby interview questions for freshers and beginners start with the language fundamentals every interviewer expects you to know. This module covers data types (Integer, Float, String, Symbol, Array, Hash, NilClass, TrueClass, FalseClass), variables (local, instance, class, global, constants), string interpolation with double-quoted strings, nil and Ruby's truthiness rules (only nil and false are falsy — 0 and empty string are truthy), the Symbol vs String distinction at a basic level, Array and Hash operations that come up in every interview, conditionals and loops (if, unless, case/when, each, times, while), and defining methods with default arguments. Every answer uses beginner-level language — no internals, no GVL, no object allocation. Just the Ruby a junior developer needs to know on day one.
